lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance, sub-circular clusters arranged in approximately six horizontal rows and at least seven vertical columns across the mid-lateral flank posterior to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, creating a lattice-like visual structure across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature situated along the mid-lateral flank, defined by a sharp luminance gradient with higher pixel values on the dorsal side and a shadow-induced drop on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible anterior section of the first dorsal fin displays a sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs, with approximately four distinct spots visible within the fin's silhouette.
